nodes.label: Malicious Member Threat Model
nodes.rationale: Members may forge reports, impersonate others or corroborate more than once.

nodes.label: Separação de domínio e prefixos de comprimento nas assinaturas
nodes.norm_label: separacao de dominio e prefixos de comprimento nas assinaturas
nodes.rationale: A signature of one type cannot be reused in another type or epoch

nodes.label: Anonymous Corroboration
nodes.rationale: Corroboration count acts as confidence indicator; each member at most once per report and never on own reports.

nodes.label: Dispute Resolution
nodes.rationale: False reports could poison blocklists; only the Arbiter can reveal reporter identity, corroborators stay protected.

nodes.label: Member Enrollment and Revocation
nodes.rationale: Revoked member (left federation or keys compromised) can no longer publish, corroborate or read new reports.

nodes.label: Publish/Subscribe Distribution Broker
nodes.rationale: All reports/corroborations go to all active members, who may be offline and must retrieve missed items later.

nodes.label: Incident Report JSON Format
nodes.rationale: Fixed for interoperability: report_id (random UUID), incident_type, indicators (prefixes, ASNs, ports, protocols), observation_period (ISO 8601 UTC), severity, recommended_mitigation; security fields (signatures, timestamp tokens, pseudonyms) may wrap it.

nodes.label: Flexible Unlinkability
nodes.rationale: Full unlinkability conflicts with double-corroboration prevention, revocation and dispute de-anonymisation; groups must choose a level (none, per report, per time period, full) and justify costs and residual risks.

nodes.label: Trusted Timestamping Requirement
nodes.rationale: Verifiable timestamps establish report order (who reported first) and prevent replay of old reports/corroborations.

nodes.label: Member blacklist at coordinator (new epoch per revocation)
nodes.norm_label: member blacklist at coordinator (new epoch per revocation)

nodes.label: Automatic corroboration updates after viewing report
nodes.norm_label: automatic corroboration updates after viewing report

nodes.label: Apache Kafka
nodes.rationale: Suggested by professor; persistent log with offsets allows offline members to recover history, total order within a partition. Broker treated as honest-but-curious and sees only ciphertext.
nodes.source_file: docs/Plataforma de partilha privada de incidentes estado das decisões.md

nodes.label: Anonymous authentication mechanism
nodes.rationale: Candidates: group signatures, blind signatures, anonymous credentials, rotating pseudonyms; must be built on `cryptography`.
nodes.source_file: docs/Plataforma de partilha privada de incidentes estado das decisões.md

nodes.label: Separation of roles (Arbiter/Coordinator/CA/TSA)
nodes.rationale: If one entity could enroll, revoke and de-anonymize, collusion would have no barrier.

nodes.label: pk_E blacklist alternative
nodes.rationale: Stronger per-credential blocking, but Coordinator would learn which pk_E belongs to whom, losing anonymity vs Coordinator (today it records only (member, epoch)).

nodes.label: K_adm (shared admission key, HMAC per envelope)
nodes.norm_label: k_adm (shared admission key, hmac per envelope)
nodes.rationale: Gateway is anonymous and Coordinator issues credentials in batches of up to 6 epochs (3 days); revoked member keeps valid credentials, CRL only blocks login cert. K_adm rotates per epoch and per revocation (version V+1) and is sent via control to active members except the revoked; weakness: shareable by a dishonest active member, but revoked member still cannot read (no K_c). Chosen to preserve anonymity vs Coordinator, accepting weaker write revocation as declared limitation.

nodes.label: Privacy-Preserving Security Incident Sharing Platform
nodes.rationale: Federation of network operators (ISPs, campus, enterprise at same IXP) coordinate response to DDoS, scanning, botnet C2, BGP hijacking while protecting reporters from reputational exposure; each mechanism must be justified and compared to at least one alternative.

nodes.label: Lote de credenciais (até 6 épocas)
nodes.rationale: Member requests a batch once a day at staggered hours to reduce timing correlation; renewal ~2 epochs before end with random delay

nodes.label: Revogação por CRL assinada pela CA (RFC 5280)
nodes.norm_label: revogacao por crl assinada pela ca (rfc 5280)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over OCSP/short-lived certs; CRL installed on broker and Arbiter, never published to members

nodes.label: ECIES (X25519 efémero, HKDF-SHA256, AES-GCM)
nodes.rationale: Delivers K_c to each directory member, one entry per recipient; alternative broadcast/tree encryption or single group key; distinct info per use to prevent ciphertext reuse

nodes.label: Pseudónimos por época (12h, pk_E/sk_E)
nodes.rationale: Unlinkability between epochs; alternative to linkable ring/group signatures and anonymous credentials

nodes.label: Cadeia HKDF de pseudónimos (sk_E = HKDF(CK_E,key), CK_E+1 = HKDF(CK_E,next))
nodes.norm_label: cadeia hkdf de pseudonimos (sk_e = hkdf(ck_e,key), ck_e+1 = hkdf(ck_e,next))
nodes.rationale: Used secrets are deleted so a leaked seed does not expose past pseudonyms (forward secrecy)

nodes.label: Admissão no Gateway via HMAC-SHA256 com K_adm
nodes.norm_label: admissao no gateway via hmac-sha256 com k_adm
nodes.rationale: Rotated each version V; avoids Coordinator storing pk_E (alternative pk_E blacklist). Own scheme, not validated in publications

nodes.label: Cofre em duas camadas (Arbiter interior, Coordinator exterior)
nodes.norm_label: cofre em duas camadas (arbiter interior, coordinator exterior)
nodes.rationale: Neither Kafka readers nor Arbiter alone can open identity; alternative member-created vault or Shamir-split Arbiter key

nodes.label: Arbiter (serviço isolado)
nodes.rationale: Request limit per member so it does not act as a de-anonymization oracle

nodes.label: Cifra para destinatário X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-GCM (estilo ECIES)
nodes.norm_label: cifra para destinatario x25519 + hkdf-sha256 + aes-gcm (estilo ecies)
nodes.rationale: Alternative RSA-OAEP rejected due to ~190 byte limit

nodes.label: Chave de época K_ep distribuída pelo Kafka
nodes.norm_label: chave de epoca k_ep distribuida pelo kafka
nodes.rationale: Replaced later by per-message K_c; revocation opens a new epoch and distributes new K_ep to active members only

nodes.label: Chaves de longa duração do membro (sk_login Ed25519 + X25519)

nodes.rationale: Single key for everything rejected: mixes signing with decryption
